# Normalize CSS

`normalize.css` is the default CSS generated from normalize-scss 7.0.1 at commit
`fc72fd3536ad0f9c7a1c492c4eacc1d74c0f0f5d` using Hugo Extended 0.125.7 (LibSass,
expanded output). The entry point was `sass/normalize/_import-now.scss`, with no
variable overrides.

This preserves the site's existing browser defaults while removing the Sass
submodule and its build-time dependency. The file is intentionally plain CSS.
Keep its license notice and the accompanying `normalize.LICENSE` when updating
or redistributing it.

Upstream: https://github.com/JohnAlbin/normalize-scss
